title: Round 29 Atlantic state-frame USGS GNIS source register
scope: All-GNIS starter register for South Carolina. Every seeded row reproduces one accepted USGS GNIS Geocoder candidate screened by exact official name, returned type/state/county, permanent FEATURE_ID, and returned primary point. Sassafras Mountain and Rock Hill additionally carry GNIS Domestic Names per-ID checks.

usgsGeocoder.use: Fuzzy candidate discovery only. A candidate was accepted only when Name, Type, State, County, GnisId, Latitude, and Longitude all matched the intended feature. County records, divisions, canals, reservoirs, air bases, harbors, farms, heights, crossroads, census records, and same-name records of another county were rejected explicitly where relevant.

gnisDomesticNames.use: Per-ID identity checks for Sassafras Mountain (1015279: gaz_featureclass Summit, feature code 15048, gaz_elevation 1078, EMPTY description field — the 3,560-foot figure is corroborated by the official USGS Elevations and Distances table instead) and Rock Hill (1250417 seeded with census class P1 plus GSA/OPM 2200; parallel Fairfield County record 1231736 disclosed with census class U6).

selectionRules: VERIFIED=1 is claimed only for an exact official name, compatible GNIS feature class/type, intended state and returned primary county, permanent FEATURE_ID, and an official point returned by a cited USGS service.

Grouped Geocoder Types map explicitly to stored row classes: Cities & Populated Places to Populated Place, Lakes & Reservoirs to Lake for the accepted named lakes, Streams & Canals to Stream for the accepted river records, and Summit to Summit.
A stored GNIS primary point is never described as a municipal boundary, street-address geocode, generic centroid, shoreline polygon, summit outline, or river centerline.

If exact-name candidates remain indistinguishable, the state-filtered screen returns no intended feature record, the returned record does not match the intended name and type, or the returned primary point does not identify an in-frame reach of the intended feature, the feature is omitted from that frame and the failure is disclosed; roster capacity holds are disclosed the same way.

Duplicate same-name records seed only the record identified as the intended feature — by an official Domestic Names description locator where one exists, or by census class and government codes where descriptions are empty (Rock Hill P1 with GSA/OPM 2200 seeds; the U6 unincorporated twin is disclosed, never merged).

Statewide frames use explicitly synthetic relief gaussians and generalized corridors; no bundled DEM or surveyed boundary is implied. South Carolina ships a labelled generalized Atlantic coast line that is not a shoreline survey.

southcarolina.title: South Carolina statewide frame
southcarolina.frameNote: Atlantic batch: the Columbia, Charleston, North Charleston, Rock Hill, Greenville, and Spartanburg anchors are balanced with the per-ID Sassafras Mountain record (empty GNIS description disclosed; USGS Elevations and Distances table gives 3,560 feet), the Rock Hill P1-versus-U6 census-class split over the Fairfield County twin, Lake Marion and Lake Murray, and the Savannah, Santee, and Pee Dee river records. The Savannah row is the same FEATURE_ID 1253486 that Georgia's empty states=GA screen could only surface nationally. County/census-division trap piles for all six cities and the Lake Murray population-record trap are recorded.

identityDecisions.decision: Seeded after a GNIS Domestic Names per-ID check against the gaznames_default REST layer confirmed gaz_featureclass Summit and feature code 15048 at the stored Pickens County point; the description field is EMPTY, so no GNIS elevation sentence exists for this record. The 3,560-foot highest-point figure is corroborated by the official USGS Elevations and Distances table (Sassafras Mountain, Pickens, 3,560 feet), a separate USGS publication.
identityDecisions.notClaimed: The primary point is not a surveyed boundary of the high ground; the record is not claimed to carry a High Point designation or any description text, and gaz_elevation 1078 is stored as returned without a unit claim.

knownLimitations: South Carolina is a starter register, not a statewide GNIS extract. It contains 12 deliberately selected identity-safe rows.

The USGS Geocoder is a suggestion service; exact-match screening by name/type/state/county/FEATURE_ID is part of the evidence, and the returned county is primary-county provenance. Sassafras Mountain and Rock Hill additionally carry per-ID Domestic Names detail checks; the Sassafras description field is empty and its elevation figure relies on a separate official USGS publication.

GNIS point data do not supply the displayed terrain or corridors. The frame uses explicitly synthetic relief gaussians and generalized context lines; the Atlantic coast line is generalized, not a shoreline survey.
State frames are rectangles, not state-boundary clipping masks. The South Carolina rectangle includes small areas outside the state outline; no boundary geometry is claimed.
